svg.title: Claude Code: an index loaded, topics read on demand
svg.desc: At the start of a session Claude Code loads two things into the prompt: the CLAUDE.md files, which the user writes, and the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md, an index that Claude writes, one line per memory. The topic files the index points to, such as user_role.md and feedback_testing.md, are not loaded; Claude reads one with its file tools when it needs it. When Claude writes a memory it writes a topic file and a one-line pointer in the index, and Claude Code stamps the file with the time it was written, so a fact read months later shows how current it is.
svg.text: Claude Code: an index loaded, topics read on demand
What goes into every session, and what Claude reads only when it needs it. Each memory file carries the time it was
LOADED AT THE START OF EVERY SESSION
written by you: instructions, loaded whole
written by Claude; first 200 lines or 25 KB
READ ON DEMAND, WITH THE FILE TOOLS
description: run the integration tests first
Run the integration tests before committing.
Claude writes a memory as a topic file plus one line in the index; Claude Code stamps the file with the time of the write.
Near the size limit Claude Code tells Claude to shorten the index; past it, the write returns an error.
Anthropic, Claude Code documentation, November 2026 [V]; file contents illustrative
